item.title: FBI reviewing new message tied to Nancy Guthrie's apparent abduction
item.description: Tucson TV station KOLD said on Friday it received a new message, via email, tied to the Guthrie case. The station said it couldn’t disclose its contents.

item.title: A warm and dry weekend pattern for the Beehive State
item.description: Friday afternoon will feature a widespread haze across the valley areas and above-average temperatures.

item.title: Police seek public help in locating missing Lindon woman
item.description: Police are seeking the public's help in locating a missing woman from Lindon.

item.title: Former accountant from Roy charged with 68 felonies, accused of stealing over $450K
item.description: An ex-employee at an asset management company has been charged with dozens of felonies for using her position to steal over $450,000.

item.title: Residents react after string of car vandalism in St. George
item.description: Residents of a Southern Utah neighborhood were in for an unwelcome surprise on Wednesday morning. Several cars and homes were targeted and damaged, with up to thousands of dollars' worth of damage.

item.title: Utah is most likely to boycott Bad Bunny's halftime show this Sunday: Analysis
item.description: After controversy surrounding the NFL's choice of artist, Utah is the state most likely to boycott Bad Bunny's Super Bowl Halftime show, according to an analysis of data on X.com.

item.title: 90-year-old Utah skier reflects on Winter Games in Cortina 70 years ago
item.description: Marvin Melville was 21 years old when he competed in the 1956 Winter Games in Cortina, Italy. He is now 90, and he is the only living male skier from the 1956 U.S. Olympic Ski Team, according to his family.

item.title: Second location of Detroit-style pizza place Bricks Corner coming to West Valley
item.description: A second location of the popular Detroit-style pizza restaurant Bricks Corner is coming to West Valley City in May, with an exclusive gelato bar.

item.title: 'Let Utah be the model': Leaders urge Congress to invest in local transportation programs
item.description: State and federal leaders spoke on Friday on why surface transportation programs, which includes public transit, in Utah should continue to receive funding.

item.title: Salt Lake City celebrates Opening Ceremony of Italy 2026 with watch party and cauldron lighting
item.description: As the Winter Games officially kicked off Friday in Italy, Utahns came together to celebrate the Opening Ceremony, including relighting the cauldron from the 2002 Salt Lake City Games.
